artifact_scope: Read-only argument-validity and claim-to-evidence review of the fixed English/Korean manuscript bundle, generated English inputs, exact NPC/disclosure result artifacts, promotion workflow, offline QA receipt, and runtime endpoint/proposal records. No files changed.

problem_and_question.evidence: The paper clearly separates authorization/conformance from narrative and player outcomes (paper/latex/en/main.tex:35-47, 251-255, 279, 282-283). The central problem is concrete, but the paper's strongest question is a systems/conformance question rather than an efficacy question.

literature_and_context.evidence: Related-work framing covers grounding, environments, structural constraints, evaluation, replay, and repair (main.tex:66-75). Whether the combination is novel relative to the cited literature is not independently checked here and remains [INFERENCE].

methodology.evidence: The transition equation, validator vector, assumptions, and separate authority boundary are explicit (main.tex:77-100, 101-177). The empirical tests are predominantly authored closed-world fixtures; the validator and expected outputs are not independently labelled.

data_and_evidence.evidence: The active evidence is deterministic conformance/engineering evidence with no participants, no independent semantic labels, no comparator, no repeats for the Codex case, and unavailable provider/model revision for NPC P (main.tex:206-217, 244-249; generated/npc_results_en.tex:4-7; actual P row ...X01_P_rep1...json:107-113).

analysis_and_interpretation.evidence: Interpretation is unusually candid about ceilings, but several exact counts can be misread as success/safety/model rates unless readers also parse the caveats (generated/pilot_tables_en.tex:14-18, 36-46; generated/disclosure_tables_en.tex:35-40).

results_and_conclusion.evidence: The conclusion is aligned with the explicit boundary and does not claim model comparison or player benefit (main.tex:282-283). However, the NPC and disclosure tables still expose attractive numerators that have no independent semantic or model-efficacy denominator.

limitations_and_reproducibility.evidence: Limitations explicitly include missing comparator/repeats/independent traceability scores, unavailable identity, hash limitations, and absent player/efficacy claims (main.tex:99, 199-200, 255-279; generated/npc_results_en.tex:4-7).

writing_structure.evidence: The manuscript has a coherent contract→controller→lanes→results→boundaries progression and generated inputs are included at the result section (main.tex:101-228). Dense caveats and the different English/Korean generated wording create parity/readability risk.

bilingual_claim_parity.evidence: The Korean NPC narrative explicitly states O has zero independent sources, efficacy pending, and token/cost unmeasured (generated/npc_results_ko.tex:4), while the corresponding English line is truncated/less explicit in the rendered extraction (generated/npc_results_en.tex:4). Korean and English main sections also order/result-package material differently (ko/main.tex:273-306 versus en/main.tex:218-249). Exact source-level parity should be machine-checked before submission.

strongest_defensible_thesis: TRACE-RPG is a source-bound, deterministic transaction/conformance architecture for proposing, validating, repairing, committing, recording, and replaying structured game-event mutations. On the named frozen fixtures and historical engine snapshots, it demonstrates implementation-level agreement with authored predicates, bounded repair behavior, state-preserving rejection/fallback, and audit/accounting mechanics under stated assumptions. It does not yet demonstrate semantic safety against independent labels, provider/model efficacy, ontology superiority, generalization, player benefit, whole-game performance, or a current live runtime-model comparison.
strengths: The abstract and conclusion explicitly prevent the most dangerous overread: the single Codex case is not model-comparison or player-benefit evidence (main.tex:35-36, 246-249, 282-283).
Authority is assigned clearly: external model/adapters propose, while Python/Godot gates and Godot owns mutation (main.tex:43, 101-103, 147-150).
The formal transition boundary is compact and useful: commit only when all seven encoded predicates pass; otherwise preserve c_t (main.tex:80-95).
The paper distinguishes assumptions from implementation invariants and states that fixtures are not theorems (main.tex:97-100).

The generated result package retains assigned failures, separates active/historical lanes, and warns that rows have different denominators (generated/pilot_tables_en.tex:21, 46; generated/npc_tables_en.tex:16).
The paper discloses the key integrity limitation directly: unkeyed checksums and replay do not authenticate writer identity or repair provenance (main.tex:199-200; generated/pilot_results_en.tex:8).

The offline QA receipt is correctly labelled PASS_OFFLINE_ENGINEERING_ONLY and explicitly excludes scientific efficacy/full-study freeze/live readiness (qa/releases/2026-10-24-runtime-model-swap-offline/verification-final.json:2-5).

highest_value_findings.issue: The sentence “only TRACE-RPG's external deterministic gate authorizes mutation” reads like an unconditional safety guarantee, while the formal result is conditional on correct policy, faithful extraction, deterministic versions, returning callbacks, and single-process file ownership. The paper itself states these assumptions, but the headline wording can outrun them.
highest_value_findings.proposed_fix: Recast this as an architecture/property claim: under the stated assumptions and the exercised writer boundary, only the gate-authorized transition is admitted. Add an explicit distinction between a proved conditional invariant, an implementation test, and a production threat-model guarantee.

highest_value_findings.issue: The 13/13 gate agreement is explicitly a loader construction invariant: the loader admits one valid control plus one isolated instance per implemented code. The 5/5 rho and 5/5 oracle counts are over frozen, author-partitioned repairability classes. These are valid conformance observations, but not independent accuracy, safety, or repair-efficacy rates.
highest_value_findings.proposed_fix: Keep the rows, but label them everywhere as authored-fixture conformance/coverage. Add a short “not an efficacy estimator” sentence immediately before the table and avoid rate-like language in the abstract/results summary. An access-separated semantic oracle and adversarial unseen fixtures are needed for an efficacy claim.
highest_value_findings.status: Fixable now for wording; needs independent-holdout data for stronger claim

highest_value_findings.issue: The general_rule and ontology_gate arms have identical 16/44 outcomes, zero mismatch, and zero replay/state/display failures across the same frozen cases. The two arms share the frozen expectations/rules, and the two rule-change fixtures are applied identically to both; therefore there is no intervention that isolates an ontology contribution. The unchecked arm is an isolated no-check observation, not a fair baseline.
highest_value_findings.proposed_fix: State the result as “identical under a shared authored contract; no ontology effect is identifiable.” For causal/ontology claims, predefine a fresh, access-separated holdout with an ontology intervention that changes only the ontology-derived signal, plus an independent semantic oracle. Do not call unchecked a comparator for safety.
highest_value_findings.status: Fixable now for interpretation; needs pilot/confirmatory design

highest_value_findings.issue: An actual P-arm result has backend=codex but model=null, recorded_response_ref=null, and trace_ref=null; its accepted reveal_hint transition is a fixture-bound P row with hashes, not attributable model output. The table reports P/R/O each 24 assignments, 20/4 complete/fail, and 4 goal-reached, but O has zero independent sources and all arms retain assigned failures. These counts cannot support model quality, recovery efficacy, or superiority.
highest_value_findings.proposed_fix: Separate engineering protocol counts from model-attributable observations in table headers and prose. Require exact provider/model revision, source/response trace, and an assignment-level independent goal verifier before any model endpoint is reported. The planned endpoint amendment already defines assigned-denominator completion; the new study currently has zero model calls and is not executed.
highest_value_findings.status: Fixable now for wording; needs live pilot/confirmatory data

highest_value_findings.issue: The NPC aggregate's per-arm 4 assigned failures and 4 goal-reached rows are true artifact facts, but the aggregate validation fields are false (assignment_complete, claim_boundaries_valid, hashes_valid, provenance_valid, replay_valid). The generated text appropriately calls the packet historical and non-certifying for the current checkout. A reader could still infer a current runtime result from the table location.
highest_value_findings.proposed_fix: Put “historical packet; not current-runtime evidence” in the table caption or immediately before the table, not only in the generated paragraph. Keep historical counts in a clearly separate archival lane. Current-runtime claims require a current, valid, source-bound packet.

highest_value_findings.issue: There are multiple source/runtime boundaries: disclosure execution reports three source hashes differing from the frozen baseline; NPC results revalidate archived source bytes dated 2026-10-17; offline QA is synthetic and has provider_process_launch_count=0. The manuscript discloses each limitation, but a single reader-facing evidence map is needed to prevent “current runtime” and “frozen packet” from collapsing into one claim.
highest_value_findings.proposed_fix: Add a one-row-per-lane provenance table with source checkout/date/hash, runtime exercised, synthetic/live status, provider process status, and current-release applicability. Resolve/re-run hash drift before using a packet as current-runtime proof.
highest_value_findings.status: Fixable now for presentation; rerun needed for current-runtime claim

highest_value_findings.issue: 10/10 designated integrity-fault detections, 3/3 manifest guards, 1/1 known provenance-boundary acceptance, and 2/2 intentionally accepted open sentinels have different denominators and favorable directions. The 10/10 result is detector-operation conformance, not security coverage; the 1/1 replay pass demonstrates an undetected checksum-recomputing writer.
highest_value_findings.proposed_fix: Report these as a typed outcome ledger (detected, intentionally accepted, not represented, and not run), never as one safety rate. Add keyed authentication/signatures or a trusted append boundary if repair provenance is part of the security claim; add adversarial unknown-natural-language and simultaneous omission cases outside the authored contract.
highest_value_findings.status: Fixable now for interpretation; keyed provenance needs implementation

highest_value_findings.issue: The promotion workflow fail-closes C-RESULT-001..005 in TODO-RESULT and forbids pilot-only→verified-empirical. The endpoint amendment is frozen for a future budget-bounded assigned-episode endpoint, but the parent protocol is incomplete/not frozen/not authorized; the proposal is PENDING_USER_APPROVAL/NOT_EXECUTED with actual new study model calls=0. Therefore no future endpoint or proposed exploratory pilot can appear as executed evidence.
highest_value_findings.proposed_fix: Keep all proposed endpoint/pilot language in protocol/future-work text. Promote only after source-bound activation, approved assignment manifest, live calls, independent goal verification, and confirmatory review gates. Add a generated status banner to prevent accidental result inclusion.

top3_required_proof_actions.action: Run the source-bound model-swap pilot/confirmatory study under an approved activation artifact.
top3_required_proof_actions.proof: Exact provider/model revision and response trace per assigned episode; predeclared assigned denominator including failures/timeouts/refusals; independent goal verifier; no post-assignment exclusions; report primary goal completion separately from safety and semantic quality. This is required before any A/C efficacy or cross-model claim.

top3_required_proof_actions.action: Add an access-separated independent semantic/narrative evaluation.
top3_required_proof_actions.proof: Fresh holdout cases not used to author predicates/expectations, blinded independent labels or human rubric, explicit narrative disclosure and goal-quality outcomes, and a baseline that receives matched information. This closes the gap between encoded conformance and semantic safety/player-relevant quality.

top3_required_proof_actions.action: Prove and adversarially exercise the authority/provenance boundary on the current checkout.
top3_required_proof_actions.proof: Current source hashes, writer exclusivity under process/concurrency/async failures, policy-fidelity checks, unknown-natural-language/simultaneous-omission cases, and keyed append/authentication for repair provenance. Re-run current runtime packets after any disclosed hash drift; retain old packets as historical.

what_the_paper_genuinely_establishes: A clearly specified conditional transaction boundary in which encoded validators gate mutation and failed validation/fallback preserve canonical state, subject to the listed assumptions.

Exact implementation behavior on authored offline fixtures: validator code coverage, typed-error-guided versus state-reading repair on frozen classes, state-preserving negative paths, and designated integrity/accounting checks.
A source-bound read-only bilingual ontology/observer mapping declarations to typed roles and recorded decisions; it is not live hidden-state inference or authority.
A single operator-assisted Codex integration observation and an offline Godot/Web engineering receipt, both explicitly non-efficacy and non-player evidence.
uninspected_evidence_and_limits: No graphical layout inspection was performed; conclusions about figures are limited to extracted captions/text, not rendered PDF appearance.
No full raw screening JSONL line was read because individual lines exceed the reader limit; representative actual result rows and aggregate/validation artifacts were inspected.
No external novelty, citation correctness, or IEEE Transactions on Games acceptance assessment was independently checked; those judgments are [INFERENCE] if made.
No source-code implementation audit, live provider call, participant/human study, current model-swap sample, or statistical analysis was performed.

The exact complete English generated paragraphs beyond reader truncation were not visually reconstructed; bilingual parity should be checked from source files/automated generated-input diffs before submission.
The review does not infer provider identity from the string gpt-6.1-sol; the manuscript itself says this is runtime selection, not attestation (main.tex:35,246-249).
overall_verdict: The argument is publishable as a bounded engineering/methods/conformance case only if every headline result remains under its explicit ceiling. The principal residual risk is not an overt overclaim in the conclusion; it is that attractive authored-fixture numerators, same-contract ontology arms, historical NPC counts, and an offline synthetic QA receipt can be read as safety, model, causal, or current-runtime evidence. The paper should tighten reader-facing labels now and defer all efficacy/ontology-superiority/A-C claims until the independently verified pilot and confirmatory study exist.
